bio.boilerplate: Sunshine on a Ranney Day is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2012 by Peter and Holly Ranney, based in Roswell, GA.

mission: Sunshine on a Ranney Day renovates homes for children with special needs, disabilities, and/or long-term illnesses, at no cost to their families. With the help of partners and donors, we use the latest construction and design methods to provide wheelchair-accessible bathrooms, dream bedrooms, and in-home therapy rooms, ensuring safety and peace of mind for children and families.
who: Sunshine on a Ranney Day was founded in early 2012 by Peter and Holly Ranney after being inspired by a church sermon to use their resources to help others. The first makeover was completed in July 2012 for a child named Mathew.
founderStory: Holly and Peter Ranney started Sunshine on a Ranney Day in 2012 after being inspired by a church sermon about service and their time with Mathew, an 11-year-old boy with cancer who dreamed of having a military-themed bedroom. Using their background in furniture and construction, the Ranneys transformed Mathew’s room in one day and saw firsthand how a thoughtfully designed space could make a big difference for a child facing serious illness. This experience shaped SOARD’s mission to bring hope, dignity, and joy to families through meaningful home renovations.
